name: hunt_watch
_comment: Wave 12 item 1 (IFF): what bracket does an NPC get while it attacks ANOTHER NPC, and does it turn on the player? sÿst 2071 Kit Hunt Range: traffic of Kit Hunters (gövt 356, yellow discs) and Kit Prey (gövt 357, cyan discs), each the other's enemy, both AI 3 and neutral to the player (Kit Ring Tank + Kit Tickler, 1-damage turret). Phase 1: Tab through the ships with a shot each (bracket colour while they fight each other). Phase 2: target a Kit Prey (tab_to cyan) and tickle it for 8 s (now the player fights it too); Tab through again; watch the player's shield.
